displayName: OJ — OTel collector restarted in the last 5 min

documentation.content: The `oj-otel-collector` container restarted within the past 5 minutes. While the collector is down, ALL telemetry (traces, metrics, logs) is dropped by the JVM agents after their 30 s in-memory buffer. The data plane (submissions) is unaffected. Likely causes: OOM (mem_limit 512m), config-reload failure, GCP exporter auth lapse. Check `docker logs oj-otel-collector` and `docker inspect oj-otel-collector --format '{{.State.OOMKilled}}'`.

conditions.displayName: Collector container restart count > 0 in 5 min
